description: Queue up to 1000 photo URLs for background processing. op=index stores their faces in the collection; op=match matches them against the collection. Submitting is free; each photo costs 62 credits when it is processed (some accounts pay the real-time 93 for a batch of one photo). The collection is created if missing; one that is being deleted is refused with 409 collection_not_writable. Only URLs are accepted, not base64. Returns batch_id; poll get_batch or register a webhook to hear when it finishes. URLs are not checked at submit time: unreachable ones fail individually later.

collection_id.description: Collection to index into or match against.

idempotency_key.description: Reusing a key returns the original batch instead of creating a duplicate. Use a new key for each different batch.

op.description: index = store faces; match = search with each photo.

override.description: op=index only: replace faces of photos indexed before.

external_id.description: Your id for the photo (becomes its photo_id).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the photo.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: Webhook to notify when the batch completes.

name: submit_batch
title: Submit a batch job
